allocation_accounting.scope: Whole outer allocations; not added to invocation costs

anchor_definition: Exact original c1=(on,4,.45) or c2=(off,8,.60); all other settings are challenge.

classifier_vs_combined_shortcut.interpretation: Disagreements selected from frozen approved flags only, before outcome analysis. Primary comparison: errors avoided versus usable configurations rejected among combined-shortcut approvals rejected by the classifier. Both disagreement directions are reported. Outcome counts require all three planned seeds eligible; unresolved partial known unsuitability is separate from still-unknown rejections and is not a resolved avoided error. Configurations, not seed repetitions, are the comparison units. These counts do not establish an unconditional advantage or a decision criterion: usable settings may be lost, and unresolved outcomes may change the comparison.

interpretation: Outcome-motivated prospective panel. Scores use resolved configurations with all three planned seeds eligible; unresolved approvals and partial known unsuitability are separate. Paired outcomes are total execution effects: generated responses may differ. Continuous effects are conditional on completion and available measurements. Equal-case summaries describe observed contributions. Fixed batch/reservation offload strata are primary. Pooled continuous offload effects average observed matched completions, not the full grid; whole strata can be absent even when every case contributes. Empty strata are not estimable. within_margin_indicator measures completion AND margin compliance, not completion alone. No population CI or independent-run/grid inference is used.

within_margin_indicator.one: Validated completed run with completed_peak_mib <= limit_mib.
within_margin_indicator.zero: Eligible memory_failure or completed run above the margin.
